subject: Mutual Action Plan & next steps — Redwood MAP for ACME Maps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme-maps.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Recap: Discovery + MAP draft (ACME Maps)

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed Mutual Action Plan (MAP) so we have alignment on owners, milestones, and timing. Please flag anything I missed.

Key pain points you shared:
- Search/route accuracy drops significantly for custom POI layers (30–45% error in edge regions)
- Real-time tile generation latency causes delays for customer-facing map updates
- Current cost per update is high due to lack of batching and inefficient model inference on-prem

Goals:
- Improve POI matching accuracy to <15% error in edge regions
- Reduce tile generation median latency to under 200ms for 95th percentile traffic
- Prototype a cost-effective inference architecture (hosted or private) that reduces per-update cost by 40%

Suggested MAP (attached: acme-map-mutual-action-plan-v1.pdf)
1) POC kickoff — data handoff & environment access
   - Owner: ACME (Alex Johnson) / Redwood (Marissa)
   - Deliverables: sample dataset, access credentials, success criteria
   - Target date: 2027-09-22

2) Model & infra design review (Redwood + ACME infra)
   - Owner: Redwood (Dev Patel) / ACME (Engineering lead)
   - Deliverables: proposed model variant, quantization plan, routing policy
   - Target date: 2027-09-29

3) POC execution (2-week run)
   - Owner: Redwood (SE) / ACME (SRE contact)
   - Deliverables: running POC, telemetry dashboard, cost/latency report
   - Target date: 2027-10-13

4) Evaluation & decision
   - Owner: ACME (Alex + Procurement) / Redwood (Marissa)
   - Deliverables: MAP signoff or next steps for Dedicated/Private deployment
   - Target date: 2027-10-20

Stakeholders:
- ACME: Alex Johnson (PM), Sara Khan (Procurement), Engineering Lead (TBD)
- Redwood: Marissa Cole (AE), Ben Carter (AM), Dev Patel (SE)

Open items / asks from ACME:
- Confirm procurement timeline and primary procurement contact (Sara copied here)
- Provide a sample dataset and test account for the POC by 2027-09-20

Attachments: acme-map-mutual-action-plan-v1.pdf (MAP draft), redwood-poc-scope.xlsx (POC tasks & owner matrix)

Next steps:
- Alex to confirm procurement lead and dataset availability
- Redwood to share the POC runbook and infra checklist (I'll send the runbook + Drive link after Sara confirms)

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Thanks Marissa — solid recap. A couple quick notes:

- Confirmed: Sara Khan is our procurement lead and will own the contracting timeline. Sara — I'll loop you in on the procurement calendar; we aim to complete SOW approvals by 10/10.
- We can provide a sanitized sample dataset and a staging S3 bucket by 9/20.
- Engineering lead will be Priya Natarajan (eng:maps-team@acme-maps.com) — she'll join the design review next week.

Agree with the MAP milestones; one ask: can Redwood include a short runbook for data sanitization and recommended bucket layout? That will help us hand off to Priya.

Also, we've got a scheduled vendor review on 9/28 — happy to slot your design review for 9/29 as proposed.

Looking forward to the POC.

Best,
Alex

Couple technical clarifications from the SE side:

- For the POC we'll need a ~10k row sample that includes the edge-region POIs and a list of the false-positive examples you mentioned. That will let us benchmark the matching model effectively.
- Recommended bucket layout: s3://acme-maps-poc/data/{raw|sanitized|labels}/ and a pre-signed URL for the initial transfer if S3 cross-account roles are slow to provision.
- We'll provide a lightweight inference config and a pre-built container image to run in your staging environment.

Happy to jump on a short call with Priya next week to walk through the runbook.

Thanks,
Dev
